company_overview.name: Northwind Labs
company_overview.entity_phrasing_on_documents: Northwind Labs (operating under Rivera Holdings LLC)
company_overview.one_sentence: Northwind Labs builds internal tools, data plumbing and automations for small and mid-size businesses whose systems do not talk to each other.
company_overview.mission: Remove the manual work that accumulates in the gap between two systems nobody planned to connect, and leave behind something the client's own people can run.
company_overview.vision: A book of recurring, diversified work where no single client can end the business by changing their mind.

current_state.honest_summary: Solo, single-client concentration, project-based revenue. Two phases delivered for one retailer and one paid diagnostic for a clinic group. A third phase is proposed and undecided. The productized sprint has been defined and has zero closes.
current_state.primary_constraint: Distribution, not delivery. The work delivers and gets paid; the pipeline is one relationship deep.
current_state.revenue_shape: Project-based, phased, fixed price. No recurring line yet. Live figures are generated into knowledge/business/MONEY.md and are never restated here.
current_state.concentration_risk: One client is effectively the whole book. Stated plainly rather than softened. The measured percentage is generated by scripts/money, not typed anywhere.
current_state.next_decision_point: The outbound gate in knowledge/business/outbound-offer.md, measured at 30 logged conversations.

value_proposition.primary_value: The recurring manual workaround between two systems stops being a person's job, and starts being a job that either ran or raised an alert.
value_proposition.unique_mechanism: Deterministic plumbing first, monitoring and alerting as part of the deliverable rather than as a later phase, and AI used only at the one step that genuinely needs judgment.
key_differentiators: The deliverable runs in production and tells you when it breaks, which is the part most automation work skips
Fixed scope and fixed price with the exclusions written down before the invoice, so a scope change is a re-quote rather than an argument
We sync the systems the client already has instead of proposing a migration
value_proposition.core_philosophy: An automation is not finished until it can tell you it broke.
value_proposition.positioning_guardrail: Every pull toward becoming a product, a platform or an agency is drift. This is a builder-for-hire operation with a productized entry point, and anything wider competes on someone else's terms.

ideal_client_profile.technical_precondition: the systems expose an API, an export, or a reachable database

competitive_positioning.vs_integration_platforms: Platforms connect products. The buyer's problem is the exceptions their business actually runs on, and those are custom by definition.
competitive_positioning.vs_no_code_agencies: A flow without error handling, retries and alerting is a demo. The differentiator is the reliability layer, and it is checkable in week one.
competitive_positioning.vs_ai_consultants: We lead with the manual task being removed, not with the technology. AI appears where judgment is genuinely needed and nowhere else.
competitive_positioning.vs_hiring_an_ops_person: A hire is hands. This is the system the hands were compensating for. Both can be true, and saying so is more credible than pretending otherwise.
competitive_positioning.vs_replacing_the_systems: A migration is a much larger project that solves the problem by replacing it with a bigger one. We sync what exists.
